audits.title: An audit: fitness to drive assessment in inpatients of general adult and old age psychiatry
audits.standard: Fitness to drive assessed and documented on admission and discharge, with patient education on DVLA duty
audits.setting: General adult and old age psychiatry inpatients, Dudley and Walsall sites (3 sites), trust-wide

cycle1.result: 18/49 patients had physical health screening before medication initiation (fitness to drive figures not given).

audits.other_findings: Clinicians need education about assessing fitness to drive, especially at discharge.
audits.citation: Khan I, Asiodu N, Divyanish D, Yaqoob A, Qureshi H. An audit: fitness to drive assessment in inpatients of general adult and old age psychiatry. BJPsych Open. 2021;7(S1):S200-S201. doi:10.1192/bjo.2021.538.

audits.title: An Audit on Driving Advice After Hospitalization in a Mental Health Unit
audits.standard: Driving status confirmed on admission (target 100%); driving advice given to all patients unfit to drive (target 100%)
audits.setting: Two acute adult psychiatric units and one old age mental health ward, Southern Health NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: 42% (15) had driving status confirmed on/during admission.

cycle2.result: 47% (24) had driving status confirmed; 6% improvement in drivers informed they were unfit to drive; 22% increase in DVLA advice given; DVLA notifications increased by 18%.

audits.citation: Elsankary M, Fawaz I, Shazad F, Elashmawy M. An Audit on Driving Advice After Hospitalization in a Mental Health Unit. BJPsych Open. 2022;8(S1):S153-S154. doi:10.1192/bjo.2022.436.

audits.title: Clinical Audit and Reaudit of Driving Risk Assessment During Leave Risk Discussions Within an Adult Mental Health Inpatient Hospital
audits.standard: Local policy: leave risk discussion capturing driving risk before home leave; DVLA advice documented in notes and discharge summaries
audits.setting: Adult acute inpatient wards, Tees, Esk and Wear Valleys NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: Leave risk discussion compliance 73%; 5% of drivers given written DVLA guidance on discharge letters

cycle2.result: 100% compliance with leave risk discussion; 56% had DVLA advice recorded on discharge summary

audits.other_findings: Improvement plan agreed: MDT communication, junior doctor induction and driving advice added to discharge meeting checklist.
audits.citation: Muzenda M, Loh Z, Mahmoud N, Khan A, Kour J, Nzekwe A. Clinical Audit and Reaudit of Driving Risk Assessment During Leave Risk Discussions Within an Adult Mental Health Inpatient Hospital. BJPsych Open. 2022;8(S1):S167-S168. doi:10.1192/bjo.2022.470.

audits.title: Audit Against DVLA Guidance for New Psychiatric Patient Referrals at the Early Intervention for Psychosis Team (EIP)
audits.standard: DVLA guidance: documentation of diagnosis, driving status, vehicle type, advice on effect on driving, restrictions and legal duty to inform DVLA
audits.setting: Early Intervention for Psychosis team, Mersey Care NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: Diagnosis documented 95% (38); driving status 67.5% (27); vehicle type 33% (5) of drivers; told condition may affect driving 33% (5); driving restrictions advice 67% (10); legal duty to inform DVLA 47% (7).

audits.other_findings: Recommendations: training, team meetings, adding driving to structured initial assessments and patient leaflets.
audits.citation: Radhakrishnan T, Lathif N. Audit Against DVLA Guidance for New Psychiatric Patient Referrals at the Early Intervention for Psychosis Team (EIP). BJPsych Open. 2022;8(S1):S170-S170. doi:10.1192/bjo.2022.476.

audits.title: A DVLA Notification Audit in Forensic Supported Accommodation
audits.standard: DVLA guidelines and GMC advice on informing patients of their duty to notify the DVLA
audits.setting: Community forensic supported accommodation, Cumbria, Northumberland, Tyne and Wear NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: DVLA discussion documented in 4/12; the 4 licence holders (2 full, 2 provisional) had 100% documented discussion and notification; 8 patients had no documentation about driving or DVLA.

audits.other_findings: Authors recommend DVLA discussions for all patients with notifiable diagnoses regardless of driving status.
audits.citation: Lin C, Lim N, Sud N. A DVLA Notification Audit in Forensic Supported Accommodation. BJPsych Open. 2022;8(S1):S177-S177. doi:10.1192/bjo.2022.493.

audits.title: Driving in Home Treatment Teams: Are We Talking About It Enough? An Audit Covering Kingston and Richmond Boroughs in South West London and St George's NHS Trust
audits.standard: DVLA advice on driving and notification during changes in mental health condition
audits.setting: Kingston and Richmond Home Treatment Teams, South West London and St George's NHS Trust
audits.intervention: Findings presented at Trust-wide HTT governance meeting; driving prompt added to the initial assessment proforma and DVLA leaflet added to the welcome pack.

audits.title: An Audit to Assess Compliance With DVLA Guidelines on a Mental Health Rehabilitation Unit
audits.standard: DVLA guidance on driving with psychiatric disorders
audits.setting: Rathbone Rehabilitation Centre (mental health rehabilitation unit)

cycle1.result: Driving status documented in 9 (18%); vehicle type 0%; of 3 drivers, 2 (67%) advised on restrictions and 67% told of duty to inform the DVLA.

audits.intervention: Action plan: record driving status and vehicle type on the Rio admission clerking proforma, inform patients at first ward review, and consider driving in risk assessment.
audits.other_findings: All 51 (100%) had a mental health diagnosis documented.
audits.citation: Popoola O, Baruah R, Gilbey S, Pentz O. An Audit to Assess Compliance With DVLA Guidelines on a Mental Health Rehabilitation Unit. BJPsych Open. 2024;10(S1):S255-S256. doi:10.1192/bjo.2024.618.

audits.title: Dementia and Driving (2nd Cycle Audit)
audits.standard: GMC guidance on fitness to drive and DVLA reporting, and Driving with Dementia or Mild Cognitive Impairment Consensus Guidelines
audits.setting: Memory clinic, Watermill resource centre, Berrywood Hospital

cycle1.result: Informed to report to DVLA 73%; informed to report to insurer 45%.

cycle2.result: Informed to report to DVLA 80% (4 of 5 drivers); informed to report to insurer 0% overall (1 of 5 drivers, 20%). Risk assessment recorded in 34 of 40.

audits.other_findings: No documentation of advice on the consequences of not reporting; 3 patients were referred to occupational therapy for driving assessment. Use of a standard template was recommended.
audits.citation: Al-Dabbagh M, Muhammad F, Odegbaro D. Dementia and Driving (2nd Cycle Audit). BJPsych Open. 2025;11(S1):S214-S214. doi:10.1192/bjo.2025.10543.

audits.title: Improving Adherence to the Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) Guidance on Documented Driving Advice for Psychiatric Patients Managed by a Home Treatment Team (HTT): A Two-Cycle Quality Improvement Project
audits.standard: DVLA 'Assessing fitness to drive: a guide for medical professionals' – driving advice given and documented

cycle1.result: Driving advice documented in 25/86 (29.1%); not documented in 61/86 (70.9%).

audits.intervention: MDT checklist prompt on driving status and advice, patient information leaflet on DVLA advice, presentation at a Learning-From-Excellence meeting, and staff education leaflet and teaching.

cycle2.result: Driving advice documented in 76/93 (81.7%); absolute improvement of 52.6%.

audits.other_findings: Where advice was applicable (54/93), it was documented in 29/36 female (80.6%) and 14/18 male (77.8%) patients. Future work will assess the quality of advice given.
audits.citation: Ezemagu-Onedi C, Fisher E. Improving Adherence to the Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) Guidance on Documented Driving Advice for Psychiatric Patients Managed by a Home Treatment Team (HTT): A Two-Cycle Quality Improvement Project. BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S6-S6. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11160.

audits.title: Improving Documentation of Driving Status and DVLA Advice in Liaison Psychiatry: A Quality Improvement Project
audits.standard: GMC and DVLA guidance: assess driving status, advise and document
audits.setting: Liaison psychiatry service, acute hospital, West London NHS

cycle1.result: Driving status documented in 5%; no documented DVLA advice when indicated.

audits.intervention: Driving status and DVLA advice prompt added to the assessment template, verbal and email reminders, sharing case learning and visual prompts in the team office (PDSA cycles)

cycle2.result: Driving status documented in 50% by week three; DVLA advice provided in 13.6%.

audits.other_findings: Gaps persisted in giving DVLA advice once driving status was confirmed.
audits.citation: Ali M. Improving Documentation of Driving Status and DVLA Advice in Liaison Psychiatry: A Quality Improvement Project. BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S134-S134. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11263.

audits.title: Documentation of Driving Status and Driving Advice for Adult Mental Health Inpatients: A Quality Improvement Project
audits.standard: Project aim of 10% improvement in documentation of driving status and driving advice within 8 weeks
audits.setting: Acute adult mental health inpatient unit, Belfast Health and Social Care Trust

cycle1.result: Driving status documented in 48 patients (median 60%); driving advice documented for 10 of 20 drivers (median 50%).

audits.intervention: Education session for resident doctors on driving regulations; poster prompt in the resident workspace; mandatory driving status field in the discharge meeting template.

cycle2.result: Driving status documented in 53 patients (median 83%) with a run chart shift; driving advice documented for 17 of 27 drivers (median 80%).

audits.other_findings: Driving advice documentation varied widely week to week with several weeks of zero compliance and no run chart shift.
audits.citation: Coulter R, Norris E, Turkington A. Documentation of Driving Status and Driving Advice for Adult Mental Health Inpatients: A Quality Improvement Project. BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S146-S146. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11365.

audits.title: Driving Advice on Discharge: An Audit of Compliance With DVLA and GMC Standards in Psychiatric Care
audits.standard: DVLA and GMC standards: advise patients when mental state or medication may affect driving, inform them of duty to notify the DVLA, and document this
audits.setting: Edisford and Hyndburn psychiatric inpatient wards, Royal Blackburn Hospital

cycle1.result: 19 (95%) on psychotropics that may impair driving; only 1 had documented driving advice at discharge; no documented DVLA contact by clinicians.

audits.other_findings: Ward education on DVLA and GMC standards and a re-audit after 1 month are recommended.

audits.title: Assessment of Driving Status and Notification of DVLA Advice Within an Acute Inpatient Psychiatric Setting – a Closed Loop Audit
audits.standard: DVLA guidance: patients admitted for serious mental illness should not drive for 3 months after stabilisation and should inform the DVLA
audits.setting: Working-age adult acute inpatient psychiatric ward, Surrey and Borders Partnership NHS Trust

cycle1.result: Driving status explored 25%; of these 67% given DVLA advice and 67% told to inform the DVLA.

audits.intervention: Added a 'driving status' field to the electronic ward round template to standardise screening at ward reviews.

cycle2.result: Driving status explored 85%; of drivers 86% given DVLA advice (from 67%) and 71% advised to contact the DVLA (from 67%).

audits.other_findings: Further planned actions were ward posters, gathering information on MDT awareness and extending the audit to other wards.
audits.citation: Olotu U, Sacaklidir S, Jones G, Donya F, Ahmed S. Assessment of Driving Status and Notification of DVLA Advice Within an Acute Inpatient Psychiatric Setting – a Closed Loop Audit. BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S308-S309. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11686.

audits.title: Clinical Audit of Driving Information Collection and Advice in NY&Y CAMHS Eating Disorder Service
audits.standard: Local audit standards aligned with DVLA/regional guidance: driving status documented at initial assessment, DVLA notification advice and follow-up driving safety advice documented
audits.setting: North Yorkshire and York CAMHS Eating Disorder Service, Tees, Esk and Wear Valleys NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: Driving status documented at initial assessment in 0/48; any driving safety advice in 33.3% (16/48). Of these, follow-up advice 93.8% (15/16), advice aligned with DVLA/NHS guidance 100% (16/16), explicit DVLA notification advice 43.8% (7/16).

audits.intervention: Revised initial assessment pro forma with a structured Driving Status and Advice section and a clinic poster; patient leaflet and updated follow-up template in progress.
audits.other_findings: Where advice was documented its quality and follow-up were high.
audits.citation: Gupta N, Appuhamy K, Howel G, Feris R, Hodgson H. Clinical Audit of Driving Information Collection and Advice in NY&Y CAMHS Eating Disorder Service. BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S297-S297. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11710.

audits.title: Audit on Documentation and Compliance With Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) Guidance for Inpatients in an Older Adult Psychiatry Ward
audits.standard: DVLA guidance on fitness to drive
audits.setting: Older adult psychiatry ward, Nottinghamshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: Driving status documented in 5 (25%) despite 18 (90%) having DVLA-relevant diagnoses; DVLA advice recorded for 3.

audits.intervention: Clinician education and prompts in the ward round template.

cycle2.result: Driving status documented in 10 (90.9%); both drivers for whom guidance applied had DVLA advice discussed.

audits.citation: Palayi R, Kurungot A, Melese N. Audit on Documentation and Compliance With Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) Guidance for Inpatients in an Older Adult Psychiatry Ward. BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S335-S335. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11820.
